title: Regierungsvorlage 1237 der Beilagen XVIII. GP, Steuerreformgesetz 1993 (abolition of Vermögensteuer and Erbschaftssteueräquivalent)
found: Abolition from 1 Jan 1994; revenue effect of Vermögensteuer 8.3bn S and Erbschaftssteueräquivalent 2.1bn S; package cost about 17bn S; amnesty for unpaid Vermögensteuer; no register rows (pre-2010)
gaps: Read the cover sheets, the general part of the explanatory notes and the passages that mention the wealth tax; the other 150 pages (income tax, VAT, fees) not read

title: Bericht des Finanzausschusses 1301 der Beilagen XVIII. GP on the Steuerreformgesetz 1993, with the Greens' dissent
found: Committee membership and vote on the bill; Greens' dissent on the abolition (private households relieved by about 2bn S, wealth taxes 1.1% of GDP against 2.1% OECD average, property values 1/5 to 1/10 of market value); no register rows (pre-2010)
gaps: Technical passages on income tax and other articles not read; the plenary debate and vote of the Nationalrat in November 1993 were not found online

title: Vermögensteuergesetz 1954, consolidated text as in force on 31 December 1993 (RIS)
found: Rate 1% (section 8); allowances of 150,000 S per person, spouse and minor child (section 5); minimum base for companies (section 6); not applied to facts after 31 Dec 1993 (section 25a); no register rows (pre-2010)
gaps: Valuation sections and procedure not read

title: VfGH G 23/07 and others, gift tax (quotes and applies G 54/06 on the inheritance tax)
found: Gift tax repealed with effect from the end of 31 July 2008; the inheritance tax ruling of 7 March 2007 (G 54/06) objected to triple historic property values; government asked for the same deadline; inheritance and gift tax are outside the register definition, no rows
gaps: The ruling G 54/06 itself was not opened; its content is taken from the quotation in G 23/07

title: Entschließungsantrag 748/A(E) Gewessler, Schwarz and others (Greens), Faire Besteuerung von Superreichen, Erbschaftssteuer für Millionenerben
found: Asks for an inheritance tax only, not an annual wealth tax; no register rows (out of definition)

title: OeNB, Eurosystem Household Finance and Consumption Survey 2021: first results for Austria (Report 2023/2)
found: Median net wealth EUR 128,000, mean EUR 293,000; net wealth over EUR 1 million only in the top 5% of households; ECB top 1% share 40% against 28% in the euro area
gaps: Chapters on assets, debts and income not read in full

title: OECD, Revenue Statistics 2024: Austria country note
found: Tax-to-GDP 42.7% in 2023; property taxes EUR 2.6 billion, 1% of tax revenue in 2022, 34th of 38 OECD countries

title: Entschließungsantrag betreffend Einführung einer Millionärssteuer (Julia Herr, SPÖ)
found: Resolution motion demanding government draft a wealth tax bill on the richest by 31.12.2023; tabled by Julia Herr; read into plenary by Selma Yildirim; rejected by majority (ÖVP, FPÖ, Greens, NEOS against SPÖ).

title: Stenographisches Protokoll der 219. Sitzung des Nationalrates (XXVII. GP)
found: Plenary debate on Kika/Leiner insolvency; Selma Yildirim (SPÖ) tables 1077/UEA Millionärssteuer; vote taken by show of hands (not roll call); rejected.

title: Bürgerinitiative betreffend "Reichensteuer jetzt!"
found: Citizens initiative signed by >10,000 citizens demanding reintroduction of progressive net wealth tax of 5% on fortunes >1M; sponsored by Claudia Klimt-Weithaler (KPÖ).

title: Bericht des Ausschusses für Petitionen und Bürgerinitiativen über die Bürgerinitiative (15/BI)
found: Formal committee report forwarding 15/BI to the Budgetausschuss; summarizes demands for net wealth tax.

title: Entschließungsantrag betreffend Gewährleistung eines fairen Beitrages der Reichen zum Sozial- und Bildungsstaat
found: Resolution motion tabled by Eva Glawischnig-Piesczek and Greens demanding Vermögenssteuer / contribution from wealthiest; rejected.

title: Stenographisches Protokoll der 75. Sitzung des Nationalrates (XXIV. GP)
found: Plenary debate on budget and taxation; Eva Glawischnig-Piesczek introduces 460/UEA; vote by show of hands; rejected.

found: Debate on Covid-19 measures; Schellhorn motion 99/UEA voted down by show of hands.

found: Plenary debate on healthcare financing; vote on 1265/UEA rejected by show of hands.
